name: Wine Valley (dryland wheat hills, Walla Walla WA)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2), made against the NAIP photo of the course (2026-11-13). Wine Valley lies in the rolling loess wheat country west of Walla Walla, at about 600 ft: irrigated bentgrass fairways and greens, a vivid green against a broad golden-straw native rough of bunchgrass on the hill faces (F0-F2, the rough's lut); off the course (L0-L2) wheat fields, the young wheat a dusty olive green and the stubble a pale tan, so out of bounds reads apart from the rough; pale tan sand in the rugged bunkers; deep green-blue irrigation ponds. Trees: black locust and Lombardy poplar windbreaks (assets-src/trees_wine_valley.py). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
